items.title: ‘Leave no one behind’: As wealth gap widens, UN calls for new industrial deal for world’s poorest
items.summary: Ministers and leaders from the world’s 44 least developed countries have pledged to accelerate industrialisation that benefits all, and strengthen resilience in the face of global challenges, at an international UN conference in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
